capabilities: generate images from text prompts with built-in SD-Turbo / SDXL-Turbo models running on WebGPU
connect to local Draw Things, AUTOMATIC1111, Forge, SD.Next servers or a ComfyUI workflow for generation
create image variations from a reference image (img2img) with a denoising slider and crop tool
save results as vault attachments or notes with recipe frontmatter, and revisit past generations in a history tab
expose a generate/save API so other Obsidian plugins can trigger image generation
extras: Manifest warns the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Built-in models are Stability AI Community License — commercial use of generated images is limited; check before commercial use. Model weights (~2.6–7.1 GB) download on demand to the Obsidian profile cache, outside the vault, and are never synced. Mobile only works via the Image Playground mode; full guides live at jkaindl.de/uplink/apple-shortcuts.
problem: Obsidian has no way to generate images in-vault, and cloud generators require sending prompts and results to outside services instead of keeping generation private and on-device.

relations.evidence: a local image server you run yourself — Draw Things, AUTOMATIC1111, Forge, or SD.Next over their shared A1111-compatible HTTP API
AUTOMATIC1111 (stable-diffusion-webui): Launch it with the --api flag
Forge (stable-diffusion-webui-forge): Same A1111-compatible API — launch with --api
SD.Next: Same A1111-compatible API family — check its docs for the equivalent launch flag
point it at your own running ComfyUI server and hand it a workflow you exported in the API format
Runs entirely on-device through Apple's Image Playground via a Shortcut you install once
Recommended — via AnySource Sideloader, which installs and updates plugins from any git forge

requires.name: Draw Things / AUTOMATIC1111 / Forge / SD.Next / ComfyUI server
Apple Shortcut (Image Playground) requiring iOS/macOS 26+ and Apple Intelligence

summary: Local AI image generator that runs Stable Diffusion models on your GPU via WebGPU, a local A1111-compatible server, ComfyUI, or Apple Image Playground.
